description:
The tail of fz-5xp.16, split off so that ticket closes on the groups it
unblocked. Nothing here is blocked; it is library work.

REMAINING (a) PAIRS, all pure list/reduce with no new primitives:
    chunk_every/3,4  chunk_while/4  flat_map_reduce/3  reverse_slice/3
    slide/3  zip/1  zip_reduce/3,4  zip_with/2,3  slice/2,3

FROM THE DIVERGENCE AUDIT:

  * fz's Enumerable carries a FIFTH callback Elixir does not have,
    reduce_while/3, and every impl carries it. That is a real design fork and
    wants a decision rather than drift -- and it bears on fz-5xp.70
    (Collectable) and fz-5xp.71 (Stream), which both have to say which
    callbacks a protocol owes.
  * DELETE Enum.slice/1: an {:error, :unsupported} stub with no caller and no
    Elixir counterpart. Elixir's API is slice/2 and slice/3.
  * Enumerable.List.slice/1 should answer {:ok, 0, fn _,_,_ -> [] end} for [],
    not {:error, :unsupported}.
  * take/2 and drop/2 with NEGATIVE amounts are two-pass (count, then walk);
    Elixir uses a single-pass circular buffer.
  * list.fz member?/2 binds unused head/tail vars, and warnings are errors.
title: Enum: the remaining pure list/reduce pairs and the divergence-audit items
